tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// mdor byas kyi sa bcad bzhugs// ༄༅// 'di la gnyis te srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ lha bsgom pa'o// de la gnyis/ stong pa nyid du bsgom pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro// de la gnyis/ rten gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa lha bsgom pa'o// dang po la dngos gzhi bsgrub pa'o// gzhal yas khang bskyed pa gdan bsgom pa'o// lha bskyed pa la gsum/ sbyong ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog go /dang po la gsum/ lhag par mos pa pha mes kyi ting nge 'dzin rnal 'byor rnam bzhi/ bu tsha'i ting nge 'dzin rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin no// bar pa la bzhi/ rnal 'byor dang rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po'o// dang po la gnyis/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa dang*/ lha'i rgyu mthun bsgom pa'o// rjes su rnal 'byor ni rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom pa nyid do// shin tu rnal 'byor la gnyis/ rdo rje mgon po sgyur ba dang*/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o// rnal 'byor chen po la gnyis/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa'o// gsum pa rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la lnga/ rig ma 'du bya ba/ rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ las la gnas pa/ mchod pa bya ba/ bha gar lha bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ lha re re zhing dbyung ba/ spro ba/ bsdu ba/ gsal gdab pa ste bzhi bzhi'o// gsum pa las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la bdun/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ ngag gis bzlas pa dang*/ don dam par 'jug pa dang*/ lha mo'i glus bslang ba dang*/ bstod cing mchod pa dang*/ nye bar bsdu ba'o// ༄༅// pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi snying po'i gzungs// na mo dhar+m+ma kā ya sam+bho ga kā ya nir+m+māṇa kā ya/

tad+ya thā/ dā na pā ra mi tā/ shī la pā ra mi tā/ k+ṣān+ti pā ra mi tā/ bīr+ya pā ra mi tā/ dh+yā na pā ra mi tā/ pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ sarba dharma shū n+ya tā swā hā// //ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e wa bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
